docs/showcase.html:656 —

## Commands

heading contains a literal '##' prefix. This is intentional (spec says '## Commands section') and the test asserts `

## Commands

`, but the rendered page will display '## Commands' as the visible heading. Minor cosmetic oddity; the test explicitly validates this string so it is a deliberate choice matching spec.

docs/showcase.html:342 — Only m1-review-oauth-cb SVG node carries the 'Verifier: subagent { agent: charter-reviewer }' annotation. m1-review-session (line ~345) does not, but the spec only requires the DAG *example* to show planner-authored review with the Verifier annotation; one annotated node is sufficient to illustrate the pattern.

tests/v22-showcase.test.ts:49 — The 'does NOT reference auto-injection outside historical note' test uses a regex replace on one match only. If the historical note appeared twice the replacement would only strip the first occurrence. This is a latent test fragility; in practice there is only one historical note so the test passes correctly.
